title: Retraction and Republication: Primary Prevention of Cardiovascular Disease with a Mediterranean Diet. N Engl J Med 2013;368:1279-90.
authors: Estruch R, Ros E, Salas-Salvadó J, Covas MI, Corella D, Arós F, et al.
result: Letter of the authors retracting the 2013 report because of irregularities in the randomisation procedures and announcing a new report with reanalysed data. Editor's note: an analysis of baseline-variable distributions (Carlisle, Anaesthesia 2017) included 934 reports published in the Journal and identified 11 whose distributions did not appear consistent with randomisation; the editors replicated the analysis. In 5, standard errors and standard deviations had been interchanged; in 5, limitations of the analysis, such as lack of accounting for correlation among baseline variables, most likely explained the findings; for PREDIMED, the authors' review identified protocol deviations, including enrolment of participants who were not randomised.
